records.name: source_margin_numerical_diagnostics
records.detail: Not performed. No generated source table or numerical source feedback was supplied, and generator execution is forbidden during construction. Borrowed source summaries and declared transport choices have not been checked against simulated margins.

records.name: joint_dependence_numerical_diagnostics
records.detail: Not performed. The packet supplies no relationship records and no generated rows were produced or inspected. The assumed conditional law and shared-factor algebra are specifications, not numerical confirmation of marginal or conditional correlations.

records.name: tail_and_support_numerical_diagnostics
records.detail: Not performed. Positive support and age conditioning are implemented symbolically, but finite output, empirical tails, completeness and distributional behavior have not been tested through any draw or generator execution. The controller owns isolated execution.

records.name: source_estimator_precision
records.detail: Not performed. Source estimator uncertainty and field-specific sample sizes are unavailable as stated. Individual SDs, quartiles and synthetic n are not used to manufacture sampling precision or confidence intervals.
